a military court sentenced 49 defendants to death, while the prosecution failed to examine information pointing to possible involvement by senior Congolese officials; transitional-justice consultations launched in March made little progress, and Tshisekedi’s administration took no concrete steps to end impunity.","notes":["The excerpt attributes the failure to examine information to the prosecution, not expressly to the military court."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0001-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0001-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0001-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0001-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0001-E011","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The government launched an auction for licensing rights to 27 oil blocks and 3 gas blocks, opening an estimated 11 million hectares of rainforest to drilling; potential emissions were estimated at up to 5.8 billion tons of carbon, more than 14 percent of global 2021 greenhouse-gas emissions.","notes":["The excerpt says the government launched an auction, not that it completed the auction."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0001-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0001-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0001-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0001-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0001-E016","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Polling stations opened late or not at all in many areas;
